Navya retold key events from “The Cap-seller and the Monkeys.”
Answered one of two who/what/where questions without help.
Explained twice that the monkeys copied the cap-seller’s action.
Used present forms once for past events; this was not corrected later.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Navya practised answering story questions and explaining why the cap-seller’s trick worked. They clearly connected the monkeys’ actions to copying what they saw, using examples from play. They used present forms once when describing past events, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Navya to retell the story using “was,” “slept,” “took,” and “threw.”
